_why: 0.10.14: a GPU-less CI runner makes Firefox fall back to Mesa's software (llvmpipe) GL driver, which Firefox's own blocklist then disables -- canvas.getContext('webgl2') returns null and maplibre-gl throws GPUInitializationError before the map object exists (run 35819393922: 5 of 9 reds). These prefs give the runner's Firefox the same software-rasterized WebGL2 chromium already gets from headless SwiftShader. Read by BOTH playwright.config.ts (the firefox project's launchOptions.firefoxUserPrefs) and scripts/check-webgl2.mjs (the gate that proves it worked), so the two can never drift.
